echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
echo_sets.note: Her skill-weave playstyle naturally maintains the set's stacks. Nightmare: Crownless is found in Rinascita; the normal Crownless from Huanglong works until then.

echo_sets.name: Midnight Veil
echo_sets.note: For Sub-DPS or quickswap Danjin supporting a main Havoc DPS — both supportive and offensive.

echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Early-game mix for when you lack a full 5-piece set with good stats.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; low — Energy Regen appears in none of her substat priorities (Liberation costs 140 energy)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Blazing Brilliance (Emerald of Genesis as the free standard option) + 5-piece Havoc Eclipse in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Crownless in the main slot. Run CRIT Rate/DMG on the 4-cost, Havoc DMG on 3-costs, ATK% on 1-costs, and prioritize CRIT plus Heavy Attack DMG — she drains her own HP on every Resonance Skill, so master her dodge timing.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: By far her best: her constant Resonance Skill casts guarantee full uptime on its stacking Resonance Skill DMG buff. Changli's signature, not hers.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Strong ATK-scaling alternative with Basic Attack DMG bonuses.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: The classic free standard 5-star: CRIT Rate plus Energy Regen and stacking ATK on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star gacha option: Basic and Heavy Attack DMG on Resonance Skill cast.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: Accessible 4-star: 15% ATK after Intro Skill. Free last-resort: craftable Sword#18.

stat_priorities.note: Balance both; her S4 grants CRIT Rate while above 60 Ruby Blossom, so adjust accordingly.

profile.role_note: High-skill-ceiling HP-drain DPS with built-in self-healing; gets stronger with Resonance Chain. Her Outro also supports other Havoc characters on quickswap teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: One of the best 4-star DPS units in the game in skilled hands, with a self-sustaining HP-drain kit — absolutely worth building, but not worth chasing on a banner.

Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Danjin
members.note: On-field DPS; maximizes on-field time weaving skills, heavies, and her Liberation.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Main DPS whose off-field damage lets Danjin stay on-field; runs Dream of the Lost 3-pc + Havoc Eclipse 2-pc.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and sustain to offset Danjin's HP drain.

teams.name: Dual Havoc: Danjin + Phrolova + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens and Outros to Phrolova, who builds Volatile Notes and Liberates. Danjin then takes extended on-field time for her combos and Liberation, then rotates back to Shorekeeper to detonate Stellarealm.

members.name: Danjin
members.note: On-field Main DPS for the full combo loop.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Sub-DPS; drops his Liberation turret and Outros for Heavy Attack DMG, which Danjin's heavies use.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing, team ATK buff, and DMG Deepen with off-field coordinated attacks.

teams.name: Alternative: Danjin + Mortefi + Verina
teams.rotation: Verina heals and buffs, Mortefi drops his Liberation turret and Outros for the Heavy Attack DMG buff, then Danjin takes the field for her full skill-weave combo loop.

tier_badge.label: Strong
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her A as both a Main DPS and Sub-DPS (A in both Tower of Adversity and Whimpering Wastes); Beebom's 3.7 tier list places her in B — the premier 4-star Havoc DPS for skilled players.
